mechanics: You have {duration}. Agents take turns in a fixed order. On each turn you see the current swarmish.txt, the recent discussion, and your private scratchpad. You may post a discussion message in English to your team, and you may replace swarmish.txt with a new full version. Edits apply in turn order, so coordinate in the discussion before making large changes. When the round ends, the current swarmish.txt is exported as is.

_notes.n_glyphs: null lists every glyph in glyph_inventory; an integer samples that many per language.
_notes.spaces: the prompt always permits spaces, so the round 2 validator must allow them too.
